notes.title: A Major Update is ready!
notes.notes:
The hunt begins in a new dimension! We're thrilled to introduce a massive update for Evil Hunt that takes the game to the next level. Experience an even more intense and captivating ghost hunt with numerous new features and improvements. What's in store?

[h3]New, streamlined interface:[/h3]

[list]
[*] In-game journal: All important information at a glance.
[*] Version display: Stay up-to-date with the latest version.
[*] VSync support: For smooth gameplay without tearing.
[/list]
[h3]More game modes and flexibility:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Private lobbies: Play undisturbed with your friends.
[*] Revamped lobby scene: An even better pre-game experience.
[/list]
[h3]Improved gameplay:[/h3]

[list]
[*] New tripod system: New tripods with hydraulic pan heads allow for precise and quick camera adjustments for optimal surveillance.
[*] Expanded ghost logic: Rule out ghosts and receive clues from ghost lore.
[*] Intuitive item placement: Easily place and adjust items with P and the mouse wheel.
[*] Focused surveillance: Rotate cameras only on tripods and keep an eye on the rooms.
[/list]
[h3]Atmospheric innovations:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Dynamic temperature system: Experience the cold presence of the ghost and the heat of the hunt.
[/list]
[h3]Numerous bug fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] For an even more stable and fluid gameplay experience.
[/list]

[h2][h1][h3]What does this mean for you?[/h3][/h1][/h2]

[list]
[*] More depth: The ghost hunt becomes even more complex and offers more strategic possibilities.
[*] More atmosphere: Immerse yourself even deeper into the creepy world of Evil Hunt.
[*] More fun: Experience an even more exciting and captivating multiplayer experience.
[/list]

[h2]We invite you to continue the hunt![/h2]

notes.title: Evil Hunt Update Post
notes.notes:
[b]Hunters![/b]
We're excited to share the latest updates to Evil Hunt! We've been hard at work improving your gameplay experience, and here's a breakdown of what's new:

[b]Technical Fixes[/b]

•	Fixed crashes when moving the mouse out of fullscreen mode.
•	Fixed crashes during mission summary.
•	Fixed incorrect character display for other players.
•	Fixed errors when rejoining the same lobby.
•	Fixed game crashes caused by using lightswitches in the small house.

[b]Gameplay Mechanics[/b]

•	Equipment can now be mapped to number keys (1, 2, 3, 4).
•	Ghost haunting has been overhauled.
•	The game now ends only when all players are dead.
•	Dead players will have a grey overlay screen and can still move but cannot interact.
•	"Laser Grid" terminology has been unified.
•	Backward walking has been fixed.
•	Sanity safe zone size has been increased.
•	Introduction by the IFU. Banners were placed at the headquarters and in the headquarters

[b]Ghosts and Environment[/b]

•	The ghost in the Laser Grid is now green and correctly sized.
•	Trigger probabilities for Laser Grids and motion sensors have been adjusted.
•	Ghost interactions have been reduced.
•	Ghost haunting now affects all players, not just the host.
•	Events are now reliably experienced by all players.

[b]New Features[/b]

•	New achievement: Connect your game to Steam.
•	Sanity pills have been implemented.

[b]Additional Improvements[/b]

•	Issues with the fuse box in the small and big house are being fixed.
•	The motion sensor (Laser Grid Projector Medium) can now be picked up reliably.

We're continually working to improve the game and welcome your feedback!

Stay vigilant, Hunters! The Evil Hunt Team

As promised, all these new features and improvements will also be available to you with the next major update.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Enhanced Gameplay with New Ghosts, Equipment, and Stamina
notes.notes:
Evil Hunt Patch Notes - Enhanced Gameplay with New Ghosts, Equipment, and Stamina
Welcome to the latest update for Evil Hunt, the intense ghost hunting game that will send shivers down your spine!

[b]New Ghosts:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Oni: [/b]This fearsome spirit reveals its presence through Orbs, Dots, and the Ghostbox.
[*] [b]Onryo:[/b] A vengeful spirit that makes its presence known through UV light, EMF5, and Dots.
[*] [b]Djinn: [/b]A nimble and elusive entity that can be detected by Freezing, Dots, and the Ghostbox.
[*] [b]Deogen:[/b] A mysterious spirit that communicates through Ghostbook, Dots, and the Ghostbox.
[*] [b]Bludnik:[/b] A restless spirit that makes its presence known through UV light, Ghostbook, and the 
Ghostbox.
[/list]
[b]New Equipment:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Ghostbox[/b]: Enables communication with certain spirits like Deogen.
[*] [b]Dots:[/b] Makes certain spirits like Djinn visible.
[*] [b]Motion Sensor:[/b] Locates the ghost in the house more quickly.
[/list]

[b]Running Stamina:
[/b]
With this update, running in the game becomes more energy-charged. You will now consume stamina while running, which regenerates over time. This new mechanic adds another layer of challenge and strategy to the gameplay.

[b]Additional Improvements:[/b]

New ghost models for a fresh gameplay experience.
Various bug fixes and optimizations.
We are aware that there may still be some minor bugs present in the game. If you encounter any bugs, please report them to us so we can address them in future updates.

We are always working to improve Evil Hunt and make it the best ghost hunting game possible. Thank you for playing and for your continued support!

[b]Please note:[/b]

The described changes and new features are based on the current development of Evil Hunt and may be subject to change.
We encourage players to provide feedback and report any bugs they encounter to help us improve the game.
We hope you enjoy the latest update for Evil Hunt!

notes.title: Evil Hunt: Major Update Arrives with Thrilling New Features!
notes.notes:
[b]Calling all explorers and ghost hunters![/b]

Evil Hunt just received a chilling update packed with exciting features to take your paranormal investigations to the next level:

[b]Unpredictable Encounters:[/b]

Brace yourselves for brand new events that dynamically alter the environment, throwing unexpected challenges and amping up the tension. Prepare for moving objects and surprising occurrences that will keep you on your guard.

[b]Experimental Tools: ️[/b]

Delve deeper into the unknown with two new experimental features:

[b]Ghost Box:[/b] (Experimental) Ask questions and receive cryptic clues, but be aware: evidence collection won't be possible through the Ghost Box just yet. Soon, it will only react to ghosts with corresponding evidence.

[b]Ouija Board:[/b] (Experimental) Establish a direct connection with the spirits right at headquarters. Ask questions and gather information. In the future, the Ouija Board will be freely movable and will only function within the ghost's specific location.

Evil Hunt: The Ultimate Ghost Hunting Experience Awaits!

notes.title: Language patch
notes.notes:
Hey Hunters,

We're excited to announce that we've added support for several new languages to Evil Hunt! This means you can now experience the game in your preferred language:
[list]
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] Russian
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Turkish
[/list]

We hope this will make Evil Hunt more accessible to players from all over the world. We're always working to improve the game, and we appreciate your continued support.

Here's how to change your language:

Open the Evil Hunt client.
Click on the Settings Button.
Select the General tab.
Choose your preferred language from the Language drop-down menu.
The language change instantly, you not have to click on Apply

Thank you for playing!

The Eviil Hunt Team

notes.title: Evil Hunt Patch Notes - Hotfix and Improvements
notes.notes:
This hotfix addresses several bugs and issues reported by players, including lobby bugs, collision issues, visual glitches, and object inconsistencies.

[b]Detailed Patch Notes:[/b]

[b]Lobby:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the lobby would not close properly when the host leaves.
[*]Resolved a bug in the lobby list.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the lack of collision on the bars in the basement.
[*]Addressed a bug that prevented clients from using the EMF device.
[*]Corrected the orientation of books on the shelves in the living room near the fireplace.
[*]Synchronized ghost names across the network to prevent inconsistencies.
[*]Fixed a glitch that allowed players to see through walls behind the bars in the basement.
[*]Addressed collision issues that allowed players to walk through certain objects in the back room of the basement.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could glitch through the house wall into the garden.
[/list]


[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the size and visibility of the orb.
[*]Adjusted the position of the wall in the dining room.
[*]Properly aligned the bedroom door within the frame.
[*]Moved the knocking sound in the upstairs bathroom from the floor to the correct location.
[*]Adjusted various textures throughout the game.
[*]Corrected the orientation of the door from the kitchen to the garage in the garage map.
[*]Added material to the rope in the basement.
[*]Fixed a gap above the bathtub in the upstairs bathroom.
[*]Corrected the wallpaper texture on the outer wall of the bedroom.
[/list]

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by these bugs.
We appreciate your feedback and will continue to work on improving the game experience.
If you encounter any further issues, please report them to our support team.

Thank you for playing Evil Hunt!

notes.title: New Features and Bug Fixes Announced!
notes.notes:
Hunters, brace yourselves for the next wave of thrills!

We're incredibly excited about the growing Evil Hunt community and we're thrilled to share what's in store next. In this update, you can expect brand new features that will make the gameplay even more intense and atmospheric.

New Items:

Crucifix: A holy item that can ward off spirits.
Motion Sensor: Gain an edge over lurking creatures with this technological tool.
Ouija Board: Contact the spirit world and unlock the secrets of the Bayou.
Event System:

Immerse yourselves in an even more eerie atmosphere with the new Event System! Experience dynamic events that alter the environment and present you with new challenges. From objects that move unexpectedly to sudden blackouts and terrifying illusions, the Event System will keep you on your toes.

Bug Fixes:

Improved Body Representation: Items held by your teammates will now be displayed correctly, and movement animations have been optimized.
New Ghost Models:

Experience even greater variety in the Bayou with new ghost models that will add to the terror.

New Ghost Types:

The new items and events attract new ghost types to the Bayou, who will present you with fresh challenges.

Get ready for an unforgettable hunting experience!

With these new features and bug fixes, Evil Hunt is about to become even more thrilling, atmospheric, and challenging than ever before. We're excited to see your hunting adventures and hear your feedback!

Happy hunting, Hunters!

The Evil Hunt Dev Team
